profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sagent Lending Technologies
profile.summary: Dynamic and versatile professional with 3+ years of experience in object-oriented programming with a solid foundation in computer science and software development concepts. Experienced in driving features throughout the development lifecycle, from requirement identification to production launch. Knowledgeable in developing, debugging, testing, and operating APIs, Payment Systems, and cloud-based services. Independently developed a microservice using Azure Blob Storage that helped create a visually appealing and consistent consumer branding experience for a large mortgage lending software company.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architect, build, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend services and APIs using C#/.NET (integrating with SQL Server and microservices) to power our core mortgage workflows.
- Proactively monitor system health across our Angular and .NET/SQL Server environments to ensure >99.9% uptime.
-  Rapidly diagnose API/network failures, pinpoint code defects and data integrity anomalies, fix and deploy targeted issues to restore stability and minimize downtime.
- Serve as a primary technical liaison with banking clients, translating their feedback into actionable tickets and keeping them informed through each stage of resolution.
- Collaborate with product and architecture teams to scope, prototype, and roadmap new features; balancing risk, ROI, and regulatory compliance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed robust and efficient backend API’s that are reusable, easy to follow, and generic through C# .Net backend development, leveraging key OOP principles including abstraction, inheritance, and encapsulation. Provided critical support and fixes to ensure successful go-live of a large-scale mortgage application. Validated code using integration and unit testing, testing end to end functionality of CDN’s, database modifications, as well as API endpoints, resulting in the delivery of high-quality software that meets requirements, and is fully tested.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Played a significant role in the modernization of a legacy codebase, upgrading it to .NET Core, enhancing performance, maintainability, and scalability. Played a key role in a large-scale ETL data migration, ensuring seamless data transformation and integrity. Additionally, worked with the cloud-based identity and access management service, Okta, to implement a robust authentication process for enterprise clients, improving security and user access management at scale."

positions.title: Machine Operator
positions.description: In charge of working with heavy machinery; assisting with installation, repair and testing of functionality of multiple machines at RainBird while adhering to safety protocols. Assist in the quality assurance and testing of products created from machinery. Promote efficient production through hourly maintenance checks and taking down completed product numbers.

positions.title: Data Entry Specialist / Field Technician
positions.description: Support the processing of environmental compliance testing and reporting of several hundred gas stations throughout LA County. In Charge of Data Managing for all stations, Test reports, CERS submittals, repair reports, Calendar Inputs for future maintenance needed. Head of CERS (California Environmental Reporting Systems) Submittal requests for the company, in charge of safety protocol forms, site map generating, and in-depth details on station features

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Assist with court record filings, document storage, and case retrieval for judges. Support court clerks with inter-court record transfers and related duties.

honors.title: 2nd place achievement on project "Budge-It" at Local Hackathon
honors.description: Received Certificate of Achievement for placing 2nd in a local "Hackathon" hosted by the Major League Hacking Club at Harvey Mudd college. Utilized android studio to create an application that lays out the basis for money expenditures. The application uses data from specific economics websites to lay out the numbers of how much money should be spent on every aspect of life, on a monthly basis. Giving the user a better idea on what they should or should not be spending their money on to reach set financial goals.
honors.issuer: Issued by Harvey Mudd College Major League Hacking Club · Dec 2018
